purpose: Bounded independent source review of all changed crop geometry for two verified raw corpus jobs. Not an overall extraction-quality or production-approval claim.

method.source: Original score PDFs; source-only full page2 of each score inspected before contexts.
method.render: PyMuPDF at 3 px/pt; original full-width source contexts cover the union of old/new crops plus 18 pt above/below. Overlay coordinates use each actual page and pix.x/y origin. Old edges are red dashed; new edges blue solid. No source pixels are cleaned or erased.
method.inspection: All 147 contexts visually inspected in 29 contact sheets at 1440 px wide. All changed edges examined against target notes, ledger lines, slurs/ties, articulations, dynamics and headings. No new native detection, synthetic fixtures or export run.
method.limits: Visual source-area review, not pixel-perfect output-render equality or proof that every original omission is absent. Unchanged crops and unresolved K478p38 were not newly certified. Partial neighboring ink remains.

p24 s3 Violin and p52 s3 Violin: bottom contractions retain the low forte/slur and low sustained ledger note/articulations respectively.
p20 s1 Piano: Andante remains complete despite the top contraction.
Changed piano bottom edges retain low ledger notes and slurs in p8 s1, p9 s2, p39 s1, p40 s3, p44 s2 and p52 s2/s3.
p32 s3 Piano: editorial footnote text lies below the unchanged bottom before and after; this is not a new crop omission.

Physical page 38 remains unresolved: 16 detected staves versus the five-staff cadence profile. Root separately confirmed 15 main staves plus a piano ornament footnote staff; neither the page nor that annotation is approved for omission.
